summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for ERC4626 Tokenized Vault.

findings.title: First-Deposit Share Inflation Attack (Donation Dilution)
findings.description: First depositor deposits 1 wei of assets and donates 100 ether directly to vault, driving share price to 100 ether/share.

attackSurface.attackVector: Next victim's 99 ether deposit rounds down to 0 shares due to integer division, forfeiting assets to first depositor.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
